newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian minister surprised by NobEl award.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian minister surprised by NobEl award.

text.p: A senior Indonesian minister close to President Suharto said on Friday he was surprised by the award of the Nobel peace prize to East Timor's Bishop Carlos Belo and independence movement figure Jose Ramos-Horta.
"I was surprised," State Secretary Murdiono told reporters at his ministry.
"I don't understand what were the criteria by which they chose them," Murdiono said, adding that he was speaking in a private capacity.

President Suharto is scheduled to visit the East Timor capital Dili on Tuesday to inaugurate a number of public projects, including a bronze statue of Jesus Christ said to be the second largest in the world.
